question: Spike planted C Site Haven, 3v2, 35s, DEF on semi-buy. You are Killjoy (Nanoswarm, Alarmbot, Lockdown ult ready). Teammates hold Garage and C Link. How do you play post-plant?

options.label: Save the Lockdown ult and play a triple crossfire off-spike (Garage / Link / back-site), use Nanoswarm on the defuse
options.explication_courte: In a 3v2 with numbers advantage against semi-buy, you do not need to burn the ult: three distinct angles plus Nanoswarm on defuse wins the round cleanly.

options.label: Drop the Lockdown ult onto the spike immediately to force the 2 DEF out of the defuse zone
options.explication_courte: Lockdown almost guarantees the round, but spending an ult on an already-favorable 3v2 eco situation is poor ult economy.

sources_option.citation: Spend ults on rounds you might otherwise lose; burning a game-changing ultimate on a man-advantage post-plant is poor resource economy.

options.label: Stack all 3 players toward Garage for concentrated fire on the most likely retake axis
options.explication_courte: Stacking 3 on one axis leaves C Link and back-site open: DEF can defuse through the unguarded angle, nullifying your numbers advantage.

sources_option.citation: Spread out and cover the different defuse approaches; stacking one angle leaves the other lanes to the site open for a free defuse.

options.label: Advance all 3 players toward C Link to hunt the 2 DEF before they regroup
options.explication_courte: Leaving post-plant in a 3v2 to chase frags gives up your time advantage: against a semi-buy you win by holding, not chasing.

sources_option.citation: Hold stable off-spike angles and let the clock work; leaving the plant to hunt defenders donates duels and gives up the time advantage.

explication_longue:
Situation: 3v2 post-plant on C Site Haven, spike planted, 35 seconds, DEF on semi-buy (weapon disadvantage). You are Killjoy with Nanoswarm, Alarmbot, and Lockdown ult available; two teammates hold Garage and C Link.

Post-plant with numbers and equipment advantage: do not give up what you already own. In a 3v2 against semi-buy, three distinct angles plus Nanoswarm on the defuse spot wins the round cleanly. There is no reason to burn Lockdown.

Correct sequence: Nanoswarm lineup on the spike, all three players on distinct angles (Garage / Link / back-site), activate Nanoswarm on defuse sound. The 2 DEF cannot cover three angles without taking a trade. Lockdown now (acceptable) guarantees the round but wastes ult economy. Stacking on Garage (costly) leaves other angles open. Advancing to hunt (mistake) abandons post-plant leverage.

Estimated elite distribution: ~57% triple crossfire + Nanoswarm lineup, ~22% Lockdown immediately, ~14% Garage stack (costly), ~5% advance to hunt (mistake).

sources.citation: Post-plant is about spacing, off-spike angles and delaying the defuse; save game-changing ults for rounds you would otherwise lose.
Spread across the defuse lanes, hold crossfires, and use lineup utility to make the defuse impossible without a clear.
With a man advantage in post-plant, discipline and coverage of every defuse approach beats overcommitting utility or bodies.

_gaps.incertitude: Certains coachs jouent Lockdown systematiquement des qu'il est pret pour zero-risque le round ; la frontiere optimal (garder l'ult) vs acceptable (le depenser) depend du contexte de manche (map-point, momentum) non encode ici.
Estimations depuis guides post-plant/economie ult (upforge, dignitas, boostroom) ; pas de dataset sur la frequence d'usage de Lockdown en 3v2 favorable.
Positions x/y approximatives sur C Site Haven (viewBox 1000x1000, zones maps.ts) ; le spot de lineup Nanoswarm et le placement exact de la Turret ne sont pas encodes.
